instruction:
Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Your task is to create a Verilog module that implements a glitch-free clock mux. 
A glitch is a temporary and unwanted change in the output signal of a circuit. 
A glitch-free clock mux is a circuit that selects one of multiple clock signals and outputs a clean and stable clock signal, without any glitches.
Your module should have the following inputs and outputs:

Inputs: a set of n clock signals (clk1, clk2, ..., clkn), a select signal (sel)
Outputs: a glitch-free clock signal (gclk)
The module should also have the following parameters:

n: the number of input clock signals
Your module should implement the following functionality:

The circuit should select one of the input clock signals based on the value of the select signal.
The output glitch-free clock signal should be a clean and stable version of the selected clock signal.
To implement the glitch-free clock mux, you should use Verilog code to compare the input clock signals and select the one with the best timing characteristics. 
You should then use a synchronizer circuit to remove any glitches from the selected clock signal.
Finally, you should use the glitch-free clock signal as the output of the module.
label: clean
